verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence (skyvern-docs-7, skyvern-probe-4, skyvern-probe-rt-1) describes Skyvern acting as an MCP *server*, exposing its browser-automation tool to external AI assistants like Claude Desktop and Cursor — not Skyvern acting as an MCP *client* that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools. No evidence shows Skyvern consuming or integrating third-party MCP servers to extend its own tool set.
